visible_text: マイクと画面の音を聞いています
決まったことを待っています...
やることを待っています...
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く
AI が見ている資料 — まだありません

answers.q1: Partially. It shows the audio source clearly ('マイクと画面の音を聞いています' — listening to mic and screen/system audio), but the meeting itself has no real identity: it is only labeled '01:54 の会議' (a timestamp-derived default name), with no app, calendar event, or participant info to say which meeting this actually is.
answers.q2: Yes, this is explicit: at the bottom it says 'AI が見ている資料 — まだありません' (materials the AI is looking at — none yet), so it's clear no reference material is loaded right now.
answers.q3: Mostly one surface — the left context panel and right transcript panel read as a single continuous card. But the black pill toolbar at the very top (record/pause/chat/expand/more/stop) sits visually detached, peeking out from behind the main panel like a separate floating control window rather than part of the same surface.
answers.q4: The recording state — the red 'recording' dot with elapsed time (00:02) and the 'listening to mic and screen audio' line — since almost everything else on screen is an empty placeholder waiting for content.
answers.q5: The meeting title '01:54 の会議' is unclear/unhelpful since it's just a timestamp, not an actual meeting name or source. Four action buttons (リアルタイム要約/質問する/決定事項/アクション) are shown disabled with nothing to act on yet, which reads as premature clutter in an otherwise empty state. Having three parallel empty sections (決まったこと, やること, and the transcript panel) all saying variants of 'waiting...' feels a bit redundant.

weaknesses.what: Meeting is identified only by a generic timestamp ('01:54 の会議') with no link to an actual calendar event, app window, or participant list, so a first-time user can't tell which real-world meeting this is.
weaknesses.fix: Surface the actual meeting title/source app (e.g. detected Zoom/Meet window name or calendar event title) instead of a clock-based placeholder.

weaknesses.what: The top black pill toolbar looks like a separate floating overlay rather than a header of the same card, breaking the single-surface impression.
weaknesses.fix: Visually dock the pill into the main panel (shared background/border radius) or reduce the gap so it reads as one attached control strip.

weaknesses.what: The screen is dominated by empty placeholder states and four disabled buttons with no current function, making it feel sparse/barren rather than balanced.
weaknesses.fix: Collapse or defer the action buttons and secondary sections until there is real content, showing a simpler single waiting-state instead of multiple empty panels at once.
